review.audienceHint.en: For example: US women aged 25–44 who watch romance dramas. Minimum 3 characters.
review.audienceHint.zh: 例如：喜欢爱情短剧的 25–44 岁美国女性。至少 3 个字符。

review.hypothesisHint.en: For example: Will opening with the betrayal get more clicks than opening with the romance? Minimum 10 characters.
review.hypothesisHint.zh: 例如：背叛情节开场是否比浪漫情节开场获得更多点击？至少 10 个字符。

review.selectionHint.en: Selecting adds an ad to this round. Approve ads locks the selected content; budget approval and submission follow separately.
review.selectionHint.zh: 选择广告是将其加入本轮测试。“批准广告”会锁定所选内容，之后还需单独批准预算并提交。

review.sourcePreview.en: Source footage preview. This player shows the episode, not a finished ad; use the time range below to review the proposed clip.
review.sourcePreview.zh: 这里预览的是分集源视频，并非成品广告。请按下方时间范围查看建议片段。

review.unsavedBrief.en: You have unsaved changes. Save the brief before approving its budget.
review.unsavedBrief.zh: 当前有未保存的修改，请先保存简报，再批准预算。

review.noImpressions.en: Ad {n} has no impressions yet. There is not enough data to judge its performance.
review.noImpressions.zh: 广告 {n} 暂无展示，数据不足以判断效果。

review.resetConfirm.en: Reset the demo workspace? This replaces locally added titles, campaign changes and sample results with the original demo dataset.
review.resetConfirm.zh: 重置演示工作区？本地新增作品、广告活动修改和示例结果将被原始演示数据替换。

review.materialsIntro.en: Upload episode files here. The workflow below prepares English subtitles; you can create ads from video without completing subtitle adaptation.
review.materialsIntro.zh: 在这里上传分集文件。下方流程用于制作英文字幕；已有视频即可制作广告，无需先完成字幕改编。

review.noPerformance.en: No performance data yet. Wait for reported impressions before judging these ads.
review.noPerformance.zh: 暂无效果数据，请等待展示数据后再判断广告效果。
